title: Sonos Is Planning A Product Event For September
excerpt: Unsurprisingly, it’s likely to focus on AI.
content_html:
Unsurprisingly, it’s likely to focus on AI.

Sonos

Sonos will be making new product announcements in September. The news came as part of the company's third quarter financial call (although we learned about it in Janko Roettgers' newsletter Lowpass). CEO and Director Thomas Conrad, who assumed the helm of the company officially almost exactly a year ago after an interim phase, spoke about Sonos' next steps and set the stage for AI to be a core part of its business strategy.

He argued that the battles over the best and fastest model won't be the defining factor for success when it comes to AI in the smart home. "The lasting value is going to be in what surrounds the model in a real home, the hardware that can converse with quality across every room, the system that already knows the shape of a home and the way a family lives in it, the connectivity to reach the speakers, services and devices that turn a request into coordinated action," Conrad said. "That's the operating environment for AI in the home, and Sonos has spent 20 years building it."

Sonos has a history of being an agnostic player in smart home tech. While its speakers are able to interface with Alexa (and formerly with Google Assistant), the skills of Sonos' own voice assistant only go as far as controlling your music. It has also promised better performance and specs than the budget options on the market from major brands like Amazon and Google, which have also been pushing the AI angle for their hardware.

Lately however, Sonos hasn't been doing too much on the product side while it continues to recover from a disastrous app redesign in 2024 that saw steep cuts to staff and executive leadership. Trying to immediately tackle AI-powered smart home audio could be a make or break moment for the company.

Correction, July 30 2026, 3:22PM ET: This article previously stated that Sonos doesn't have its own in-house voice assistant, which is inaccurate. The story has been updated to reflect that Sonos does have a voice assistant with limited capabilities.

content_html_zh:
毫不奇怪，它可能会专注于人工智能。

Sonos

Sonos 将于 9 月发布新产品。 这一消息是该公司第三季度财务电话会议的一部分（尽管我们是在 Janko Roettgers 的时事通讯 Lowpass 中了解到的）。 首席执行官兼董事托马斯·康拉德 (Thomas Conrad) 在经历了过渡阶段后几乎一年前正式掌管公司，他谈到了 Sonos 的下一步计划，并为人工智能成为其业务战略的核心部分奠定了基础。

他认为，就智能家居中的人工智能而言，最佳和最快模型的争夺不会成为成功的决定性因素。 康拉德说：“持久的价值在于真实家庭中模型周围的环境、可以在每个房间进行高质量对话的硬件、已经了解家庭形状和家庭生活方式的系统、连接扬声器、将请求转化为协调行动的服务和设备的连接。” “这就是家庭人工智能的操作环境，Sonos 花了 20 年的时间来构建它。”

Sonos 一直是智能家居技术领域的不可知论者。 虽然它的扬声器能够与 Alexa（以及以前的 Google Assistant）交互，但 Sonos 自己的语音助手的技能只能控制你的音乐。 它还承诺提供比市场上亚马逊和谷歌等主要品牌的预算选项更好的性能和规格，这些品牌也一直在推动其硬件的人工智能角度。

然而，最近，Sonos 在产品方面并没有做太多的事情，同时它还在继续从 2024 年灾难性的应用程序重新设计中恢复过来，这次重新设计导致了员工和行政领导层的大幅裁员。 尝试立即解决人工智能驱动的智能家居音频问题可能是该公司成败的关键。

更正，美国东部时间 2026 年 7 月 30 日下午 3:22：本文之前指出 Sonos 没有自己的内部语音助手，这是不准确的。 该故事已更新，以反映 Sonos 确实有一个功能有限的语音助手。
